name: S-CORE Platform Run
description: The launch manager starts the platform daemons, then every test application; each must exit successfully. Applications log via mw::log to the console and as DLT through the datarouter. Prints PASSED or FAILED at the end.

args: timeout 60 /usr/bin/launch_manager; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 124 ]; then echo 'S-CORE platform run: FAILED (PlatformRun not reached within 60 s)'; fi; exit $rc
